## AZERBAIJAN — profile (page 126)

- Header facts: region Europe & Central Asia; income group Upper-middle-income; lending category IBRD; data status Data as reported (A); population 10.2 million; GNI 73,951; unit line US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- Total external debt stock 2025: 12,327; change from 2024: -9.3%.
- Figure 1 Total external debt, 2015–25: start value 13,179 (2015); end value 12,327 (2025). The line rises from 2015 to a peak around ≈2018, stays roughly flat at a high level through ≈2020, then trends downward, with a sharper drop in ≈2024–25.

- Figure 3 Debt ratios, 2015–25:
  - External debt / exports: 35%; -6.4%; trend: generally downward with minor fluctuations.
  - External debt / GNI: 17%; -11.8%; trend: rises early in the period, then declines toward 2025.
  - Debt service / exports: 8%; -34.3%; trend: volatile but overall downward, ending lower in 2025.
  - Debt service / GNI: 4%; -38.2%; trend: fluctuates, with a late spike and then a fall by 2025.
